title: Duplicate parameter names — all three groups are deliberate fan-out, not defects
evidence_level: read-only graph + MI override read; no mutation, no compile change
result: no mutation required — validator warnings are false positives for this pattern

Rock_NormalMap.why_not_renamed: Both nodes share the name, so one MI override feeds the sampler AND the texture-object input. Renaming either node detaches it from the override and silently reverts that branch to T_Neutral_Normal. The duplicate is the mechanism.

bUseExtendedLayers.mi_override: not readable via static_switch_parameter_values (UE stores static switches in StaticParameters); both master defaults are true
bUseExtendedLayers.why_not_renamed: One logical control driving both the base-colour and the second lerp branch. Splitting the name would leave half the graph permanently on its default.

bGaeaWholeLandscapeColor.why_not_renamed: Five switches, one name, all default false, inside the Gaea lane which is itself off (bUseGaeaMasks=false).

rule_derived: A duplicate_parameter_name group whose members all share the same default is deliberate fan-out and must not be renamed. A group whose members disagree on default value is the actual defect. validate_material's duplicate_parameter_name check cannot distinguish the two, so it must be triaged by hand, not auto-fixed.

issues: duplicate_parameter_name: Rock_NormalMap (2) — false positive, see above
duplicate_parameter_name: bUseExtendedLayers (2) — false positive, see above
duplicate_parameter_name: bGaeaWholeLandscapeColor (5) — false positive, see above
validator_state_after.note: All four remaining issues are either intentional fan-out or informational. The master has no real validation defect.
